camel_example: aliyun eiam CreateApplicationClientSecret --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --ExpirationTime 1735530123762
description_en: Creates a client secret for an EIAM application. You can create a maximum of two client secrets for each EIAM application
description_zh: 创建一个EIAM应用的客户端密钥，一个EIAM应用下，最多只能创建两个应用的客户端密钥
kebab_example: aliyun eiam create-application-client-secret --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --expiration-time 1735530123762 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplicationClientSecret

parameters.description_en: The expiration time in UNIX timestamp format, in milliseconds. If this parameter is left empty, the client secret is permanently valid. The minimum validity period that you can set is 1 day, and the maximum validity period is 3 years.
parameters.description_zh: 到期时间，Unix 时间戳格式，单位为毫秒。为空时，默认为永久有效；可设置的最小有效期为1天，最大有效期为3年。
